text: Far Gorta is a name listed in the index of the encyclopedia. The index places Far Gorta on page 180. The name opens a run of terms that begin with the letters Far. Rows beside it cover fasting, Faughart, Fea, and feast. The row for Far Liath sends the reader to the gray man figure. These entries share one page. They open the F section of the index.

okr.objective: Far Gorta is an indexed figure at the opening of the F section.
